item.title: Ledger notes 2026-11-09: resolve the 20 GAP cells in conflict between #686 and #690
item.body:
Direct-PR: hand resolution of the ledger conflicts left by #696 (AGENTS.md §8: a by-hand ledger edit is a reviewed PR on `docs/ledger-notes-*`, no script reproduction), requested by the operator in the steward's session on 2026-11-09. Docs only. Adversarial review before merge.

The problem: #686 and #690 set the same GAP cell differently for 20 cells (8 rows). The script keeps the earlier merge (#686) and lists the other as a by-hand conflict, so #690's facts were missing from the report.

What changed (`docs/migration/GAP-LEGACY-VS-SWIFT.md` only; 19 cells replaced, 1 kept as is):
- **Rule**: each cell keeps the union of both texts, nothing dropped. A guard checked that every cell still held #686's text before replacing it.
- **Legacy ref cells**: the wider line range of the two is kept; every range was read on `2fe43da3` (and `2440d79` for the old column): `AnswerView.swift:137-141` is the `ReplyDraftStore` enum inside `103-272`; `AppSettingsView.swift:575` is the footer inside `547-577`, `637` the alert inside `637-644`; `Info.plist:206-207` is inside `206-208` / `204-208`.
- **GAP-093, 099, 152, 186, 219 (behaviour/ref)**: both wordings merged (e.g. 093 keeps #686's commit `08a63c8e` and #690's picker actions).
- **GAP-210**: behaviour = #686's text (it already contains #690's); ref and final merged.
- **GAP-215 final**: #690's decision (LOT-147 in M4, split as legacy at `2fe43da3`) replaces #686's "milestone pending", and keeps #686's FEAT-016 rail and pinned sidebar, now stated as not in M1–M4; cites #655 and #659.
- **GAP-217**: behaviour and ref merged (adds #4 not merged, `FoldHandoffDestination.swift:1-57`, `MessagesView.swift:3180-3208`); final = both; **Source = `port: legacy evolution (2fe43da3)`** (the later decision, same value as 093, 099, 219).
- **Definition applied**: the **Source** and `a·master` bullets of the header (note 1 of #690, word for word), because seven rows use the new Source value and it was not defined.

Not changed here: the other ledger notes of #686 and #690 (they replay the LOT-147 and LOT-101 milestone decisions and edit the legend, convergence notes, the H.1 table and UXD rows) stay for a separate reviewed PR.

Checks: no cell token lost (script over references, line ranges, hashes, LOT/GAP/FEAT/# numbers; the 5 hits are the included ranges above and the `#655` mention, restored); 169 rows, IDs unique; `python3 tooling/docs/fold.py --check`: ok.

Correction: I wrote 21 conflicting cells in #696 and on #368; the script lists 20.
